record.original_question: It is known that the group Zω has a subgroup whose dual is free abelian of rank 2ℵ0(see 17.24 in Archive). Does Zω have a subgroup whose dual is free ℵ0 abelian of still larger rank(the largest possible being 22)? This is Question 11 in(G. M. Bergman, Portugaliae Math., 69(2012) 69–84).

Does Zω have a subgroup whose dual is free ℵ0 abelian of still larger rank(the largest possible being 22)? This is Question 11 in(G. M. Bergman, Portugaliae Math., 69(2012) 69–84).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{Z}^{\omega}$ denote the additive group of all functions $\omega \to \mathbb{Z}$ (equivalently, the direct product of countably many copies of $\mathbb{Z}$). For an abelian group $A$, write $A^{*} = \mathrm{Hom}(A, \mathbb{Z})$ for its dual. It is known that there exists a subgroup $G \le \mathbb{Z}^{\omega}$ whose dual $G^{*}$ is free abelian of rank $2^{\aleph_{0}}$. Since $|\mathbb{Z}^{\omega}| = 2^{\aleph_{0}}$, any subgroup $G \le \mathbb{Z}^{\omega}$ satisfies $|G^{*}| \le 2^{2^{\aleph_{0}}}$, so the rank of $G^{*}$ is at most $2^{2^{\aleph_{0}}}$.

Question: Does there exist a subgroup $G \le \mathbb{Z}^{\omega}$ whose dual $\mathrm{Hom}(G, \mathbb{Z})$ is free abelian of rank strictly greater than $2^{\aleph_{0}}$? In particular, can the rank be made equal to $2^{2^{\aleph_{0}}}$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed by G. M. Bergman in "More Abelian groups with free duals" (Portugaliae Math. 69 (2012) 69–84; arXiv:1104.3827), where a subgroup of Z^ω with dual free abelian of rank 2^ℵ₀ is constructed and the existence of subgroups with free duals of larger rank (up to 2^{2^ℵ₀}) is left as an open question. No publication resolving this question was found, and it is restated as a new problem in the 2026 Kourovka Notebook, indicating it remains open.

status_evidence.title: More Abelian groups with free duals
status_evidence.snippet: A subgroup G of Z^ω is constructed whose dual Hom(G,Z) is free abelian of rank 2^ℵ₀. The question of whether Z^ω has subgroups whose duals are free of still larger rank is discussed.
status_evidence.claim: Bergman constructs a subgroup of Z^ω with dual free of rank 2^ℵ₀ and leaves open whether larger free-dual ranks are achievable.
